# GreenBean Coffee — Your Daily Coffee Ritual

## Overview

Build a 5-page corporate website for GreenBean Coffee, a premium coffeehouse chain. The site should feel like walking into a warm, well-designed coffee shop — inviting, modern, and just a touch playful. The audience spans everyday coffee lovers, loyalty members, gift card shoppers, and casual browsers. The primary goals are driving online ordering, showcasing seasonal drinks, growing the rewards program, and making gift card purchases effortless.

## Visual Direction

Think earthy greens, warm creams, and rich coffee browns. Use a clean sans-serif typeface (like Inter or DM Sans) for body text, paired with a slightly more expressive heading font. Generous whitespace, rounded corners, and soft shadows should give the site a friendly, approachable feel. Photography placeholders should suggest lifestyle coffee imagery — hands wrapped around mugs, latte art, cozy café interiors. Keep the layout modern and airy, never cluttered.

## Key Priorities

- **Home page impact**: The hero and seasonal drink highlights are the first impression — they should feel vibrant and immediately actionable with clear ordering CTAs.
- **Rewards redemption tabs**: The tabbed star-level redemption display (25 through 400 Stars) is a core interactive element. Make the tab switching feel smooth and the content instantly clear — this is what convinces people to join.
- **Gift card carousels**: Both the featured and category-specific carousels need polished next/previous navigation. Six occasion categories should be easy to browse without overwhelming the page.
- **Store locator interactivity**: The search, filter toggle, and pickup/delivery switching should all feel responsive and functional, even with placeholder data.
- **Menu organization**: The sidebar + category layout must be intuitive. Users should quickly scan across drinks, food, and at-home coffee sections.
- **Responsive design** is required across all pages — pay special attention to the footer accordion behavior on mobile.

---

## Data Sources

1. Read `/app/benchmark/source_brief.md` for all content materials (text, data).
2. Read `/app/benchmark/task_input.json` for structural requirements, data placement, and interaction definitions.

## Output Requirements

1. Output all files to `/app/output/`. `index.html` must be the main entry point.
2. All pages must be openable directly in a browser (no build step needed). Use relative paths for inter-page links.

## Automated Execution Rules

There is no human operator online for this session. Follow these rules:

1. **Skip all confirmation/approval/user-input steps** — make professional judgments autonomously. Do not pause, ask questions, or wait for replies.
2. **Design decisions** — if `task_input.json` specifies `site.tone`, `site.audience`, etc., use them to choose styles, layouts, and color schemes. Otherwise, make professional judgments.
3. **Priority** — these rules override any interactive-wait instructions in SKILL.md. The skill's workflow, quality standards, and technical specs remain fully effective — only skip interactive waits.

# GreenBean Coffee — Your Daily Coffee Ritual

## Brand
GreenBean Coffee is a premium coffeehouse chain offering handcrafted beverages, a loyalty rewards program, gift cards, and a convenient store locator. Our tone is warm, modern, and playful — inviting coffee lovers to make GreenBean part of their daily ritual.

Brand colors: #00824A (primary green), #32462F (dark forest), #F3CEA1 (warm cream)

## Hero Content
Title: It's a great day for coffee
CTA: "Start an order"

## Featured Product
Title: New Citrus Energy Refreshers just dropped
Body: Introducing a new kind of energy. Now you can enjoy the Refreshers you love with extra caffeine from nature and a B-vitamin boost.
CTA: "Give them a try"

## Afternoon Promo
Title: Your afternoon reset
Body: When 2 p.m. hits and you need a little boost, we've got you covered — with tasty drinks, snacks and sweet treats to keep the good vibes going.
CTA: "Explore our afternoon menu"

## AI Recommendation
Title: Inspire your next order with ChatGPT
Body: Discover drinks that fit your mood, goals and preferences in just a few conversational prompts.
CTA: "Learn more"

## Seasonal Highlight — Fruity
Title: A new fruity twist is here
Body: Introducing vibrant Iced Mango Cream Matcha and rich Iced Mango Cream Chai. Topped with velvety mango cream cold foam for a delicious pop of sweetness, sip after sip.
CTA: "Order now"

## Seasonal Highlight — Spring
Title: Spring starts now
Body: Iced Lavender Cream Matcha and Iced Lavender Cream Chai are back in bloom, joined by the new Iced Ube Coconut Macchiato, Toasted Coconut Cream Cold Brew and so much more.
CTA: "See the spring menu"

## Nondairy Promo
Title: Nondairy, No extra
Body: Enjoy your beverage with your choice of nondairy milk — like oat, almond, coconut or soy — for no additional charge.
CTA: "Start an order"

## Menu Categories
Sidebar navigation listing all menu categories:

**The Latest:** Trending · Citrus Energy Refreshers

**Drinks:** Protein Beverages · Hot Coffee · Cold Coffee · Matcha · Hot Tea · Cold Tea · Refreshers · Frappuccino® Blended Beverage · Hot Chocolate, Lemonade & More · Bottled Beverages

**Food:** Breakfast · Bakery · Treats · Lunch · Lite Bites

**At Home Coffee:** Whole Bean · GreenBean VIA® Instant · Shopping Bag

## Rewards Tiers

| Tier | Star Threshold | Key Benefits |
|------|---------------|--------------|
| Green | Less than 500 ★ per year | Free birthday treat · Earn 1 ★ per $1 · Free Mod Mondays · Double Stars with personal cup |
| Gold | 500+ ★ per year | 7-day birthday window · Earn 1.2 ★ per $1 · Stars won't expire · 4 extra Double Star Days |
| Reserve | 2,500+ ★ per year | 30-day birthday window · Earn 1.7 ★ per $1 · Exclusive global coffee experiences · Free personalized Reserve Card · 6 extra Double Star Days |

## Rewards Redemption Levels

| Stars | Reward | Value |
|-------|--------|-------|
| 25 ★ | $1 off a drink customization (espresso shot, syrup, or cold foam) | Up to $1 |
| 60 ★ | Up to $2 off your order | Up to $2 |
| 100 ★ | Brewed coffee or tea, bakery item, packaged snacks and more | Up to $6 |
| 200 ★ | Handcrafted drink or hot breakfast | Up to $10 |
| 300 ★ | Sandwich, protein box or packaged coffee | Up to $16 |
| 400 ★ | Select GreenBean merchandise | Up to $20 |

## Rewards How It Works
1. **Collect Stars** — Earn Stars by making eligible purchases and participating in challenges, offers and games.
2. **Enjoy free treats** — Redeem your Stars for free food, drinks and more. Look forward to a birthday treat on us every year.
3. **Unlock benefits** — Keep earning Stars to increase your status and help you get to free faster. Discover more benefits at every level.

## Rewards Partnerships
- Link your Delta account to earn miles, Bonus Stars and access exclusive offers.
- Link your Marriott Bonvoy account to earn points, Bonus Stars and access exciting member experiences.

## Gift Card Categories
Gift card designs organized by occasion with carousel browsing:

- **Featured** — Spring GreenBean · A Little Perk · Friends Buy Friends Coffee · Thank You · You're A Star · Great Work Deserves Coffee · Happy Birthday
- **Birthday** — Happy Birthday · Let's Celebrate You · Happy Birthday
- **Thank You** — Thank You · It's My Treat · Big Thank You
- **Celebration** — Yay · Celebration · Cheers · Celebrate With Coffee
- **Appreciation** — You're A Star · Cheers To You · Friends Buy Friends Coffee
- **Encouragement** — Great Day For Coffee · You Got This · A Little Perk
- **Workplace** — Above & Beyond · Great Work Deserves Coffee
- **Anytime** — GreenBean · Café · Heritage Sirens

## Business Gifting
Title: Business gifting — simplified
Body: Bulk send physical or digital GreenBean Cards to gift, reward, incentivize, or show appreciation towards your customers, clients and team members. Minimum 15 cards per order.
CTA: "Shop now"

## eGift Info
A GreenBean eGift card is a GreenBean Gift Card that is purchased and sent digitally. Send up to 10 eGifts per purchase. Select a design to start! Received a gift card? Add or reload, check balance, or view Card Terms & Conditions.

Register Gift Cards and eGifts to a GreenBean® Rewards account and members earn Stars on qualifying purchases when you pay with that card.

## Store Locator
- **Order type toggle:** Pickup / Delivery
- **Search input:** Type a city, zip code, or address — suggestions appear as you type
- **Filter button:** Opens filter panel to refine results (drive-thru, mobile ordering, etc.)
- **Map view:** Interactive map powered by Google Maps with store pins
- **Results list:** Nearby stores with address, hours, and available features

## Footer Links

**About Us:** Our Company · Our Coffee · About GreenBean · GreenBean Archive · Investor Relations · Customer Service · Contact Us

**Careers:** Culture and Values · Belonging at GreenBean · College Achievement Plan · Alumni Community · U.S. Careers · International Careers

**Social Impact:** Communities · GreenBean Foundation · Sustainability · Environmental and Social Impact Reporting

**For Business Partners:** Landlord Support Center · Suppliers · Corporate Gift Card Sales · Office and Foodservice Coffee

**Order and Pick Up:** Order on the App · Order on the Web · Delivery · Order and Pick Up Options · Explore and Find Coffee for Home

steps.message:
All interactions and dependencies verified. Here's a summary of what was built:

---

## GreenBean Coffee — 5-page website complete

All files output to `/app/output/` with `index.html` as the entry point.

### Pages built
| File | Description |
|---|---|
| `index.html` | Home — hero, 3 promo cards, seasonal highlights, nondairy banner, cookie banner with dismiss interaction |
| `menu.html` | Menu — sticky sidebar with all categories, scroll-spy active links, grid of menu items |
| `rewards.html` | Rewards — tier cards (Green/Gold/Reserve), **6-tab redemption switcher** with animated content panels, partnerships, app download |
| `gift.html` | Gift Cards — **8 carousels** (1 featured + 7 category), business gifting CTA, eGift management panel, FAQ grid |
| `store-locator.html` | Store Locator — **Pickup/Delivery toggle**, live search with suggestions dropdown, **filter panel** with checkboxes, 6 placeholder stores with map pins, store selection |

### Interactions implemented
- **Cookie banner** — dismiss with fade-out animation
- **Footer accordion** — collapses on mobile (`≤768px`)
- **Rewards tabs** — 6 star levels (25→400★) with smooth panel switching
- **Gift carousels** — next/prev navigation on featured + all 7 category carousels
- **Store search** — autocomplete suggestions, Enter key support, "Use my location" simulation
- **Order type toggle** — Pickup/Delivery filters results
- **Filter panel** — opens/closes, apply/clear controls

### Design system
- Brand colors: `#00824A` green, `#32462F` forest, `#F3CEA1` cream
- Fonts: DM Sans (body) + DM Serif Display (headings) via Google Fonts
- Icons: RemixIcon 4.2 via CDN
- Fully responsive with mobile nav, footer accordion, and stacked layouts at 768px/480px breakpoints
